ja299:1.1: Before your character in our presence,
ja299:1.2: You played repeatedly in this hermitage,
ja299:1.3: Monkey, come on, make a monkey’s grimace,
ja299:1.4: We don’t find delight in your character.
ja299:2.1: By me the supreme purity was heard,
ja299:2.3: Now don’t think of me as previously,
ja299:2.4: I live engaged in meditation, friend.
ja299:3.1: If you should sew a seed upon a rock,
ja299:3.2: The Deva might rain, but it will not grow.
ja299:3.3: By you the supreme purity was heard,
ja299:3.4: Far from you, monkey, is absorption’s ground.
